findings.detail: Actual cream airway, digestive and urinary foreground was independently reconstructed from immutable quiet-v2 and twelve accepted organ floors, frozen semantic candidates, strict color classifier and declared morphology. One-path even-odd Cairo rasterization at each asset resolution proves full-coverage foreground pixels unpainted; the complete stomach food cavity remains protected. Coarse 4x-to-6x nearest mask sampling is not used as the pass oracle.

All 202 edges expose new visualForegroundIntervals, totaling 128; Data.visibility matches these and A.unitDepth uses them. All original 135 logical intervals, 202 source samples and widths remain byte/field equal to the frozen baseline. All 7184 checks passed, including midpoint/boundary evaluation and no hiddenAboveOpenFloor samples. e143 remains fully hidden; e126 has legal exposed pink-floor segments. Native cell readability remains a separate visual acceptance.

All twelve organ and twelve peripheral blood views were read at actual .15. Registered quiet-v2 removes previous traced hard background facets and retains accepted positions/alpha. The low-resolution body background is visibly softer than the new local organ floor; this is a display quality limit, not coordinate displacement.

The .15 lung, chest-trunk, pancreas and intestinal views still show noticeable diagonal cut vessel ends, dense flat red/blue overlaps and texture/color discontinuities at junctions. Full-resolution pancreas confirmed these are visible in the current 77e6 output, so geometry and protected-pixel pass cannot establish complete visual acceptance.

Full-resolution right kidney hilum and right foot were read. Kidney and bladder cream protected contours did not show blood in their cores in these samples; red/blue routes and limb anchors remain fixed. The kidney curved cream boundary has fine stepping visible at full resolution; native filtering and actual cell contrast require separate review.

Stomach, pancreas and right kidney .149/.15/.151 were read side by side; all twelve organs were captured at these levels. No duplicate organ silhouette or abrupt substrate handoff was observed in these comparisons.

Both complete production command routes were sampled from start through blood travel to destination tissue. Actual durations in the current report are approximately 131s liver-to-stomach and 486s brain-to-bladder, compressed to 15s each; positions are not teleported. The animations are not native realtime movement proof.
The brain-to-bladder route preview includes a darker intermediate scene due to existing Survival.clock day/night darkness. No art or survival behavior was altered by this QA.

limits: Offline SVG/Cairo images execute production Lua draws but do not reproduce native filtering or GPU timing.

No navigation or accepted organ outline changed; 970 frozen production movement results remain valid without rerun.
Current native evidence and restored normal menu are separately bound; four representative normal 1x cases do not substitute filming all 970 cases.
Case3/4 final PNGs precede final driver arrival, and e126 first blood frame followed by tissue travel does not prove a complete hidden-passage dynamic sequence.
Native P95 is paused DPR2, 17 entities and 60 FPS capped, toggling foreground layers while quiet base remains on; GPU, native mobile/DPR1/3 and active crowds remain unmeasured.
